scope: Non-blind revision review: prior v1 keys known. Current v2 keyed batch and solutions have not been opened. Q047 is materially new content but retained versioned ID, so conservatively also non-blind.
visualMethod: All 14 cited pages displayed as original faithful1800x1013 renders; actual arrows, frame indices, cross products, table labels and panel text inspected.

answers.reasoning: Two serial passes each visit n links with fixed-size calculations: cn+dn=O(n), not their product or a branching recursion.
p385 lists inertia, Coriolis/centrifugal and gravity. Flexible bending vibration is a genuine beyond-rigid-body effect, not included in that listed model.
The actual COM marker is in the link interior; F is net resultant and vdot_C is center-of-mass acceleration, not endpoint velocity, a joint marker or an isolated proximal force.
H_C=I_C omega. Euler moment about the COM is I_C alpha+omega cross H_C; the gyroscopic term does not vanish in every rotation.
Outward base-to-tip kinematics supply each inertial resultant; inward tip-to-base balances then give joint efforts, respecting base and terminal boundary data.

Uppercase F_i=m_i a_C and N_i=I_C alpha+omega cross I_C omega are net COM inertial resultants; lowercase f_i,n_i are the actual proximal transmitted loads from link i-1 on i, as p393 explicitly defines.
Expanding -r_C cross(F_i+R f_next) -(p-r_C) cross(R f_next) produces opposite -r_C cross Rf_next and +r_C cross Rf_next terms, cancelling identically.

f_y=2+3=5 N. Moment z=1+2+0.5*2+1*3=7 Nm. Missing both force arms gives3; missing only COM arm gives6. Option3 combines subtracting distal force/moment with dropping both arms, producing -1N and -1Nm; subtraction alone would give -3Nm.

Initialize virtual base acceleration against physical gravity: +9.81y. F=2*9.81y=19.62y N. r_C cross F=0.5*19.62z=9.81z Nm; positive z projection gives+9.81Nm. The newly added force, moment balance and axis projection pages supply all premises.
p399 embeds mechanics as physics prior and learns residual errors rather than all dynamics; neither claim guarantees safety without testing.
In tau=W phi, W is known from motion and phi contains mass/inertial parameters to be identified using data.
K_s multiplies task-position error and behaves as stiffness; B_s multiplies task-velocity error and behaves as damping. J transpose maps task wrench to joint efforts, while g compensates gravity.

p399 sim-to-real panel randomizes mass/inertia; learned inverse dynamics maps the full motion triple(q,qdot,qddot) to tau. Alternatives confuse forward dynamics, omitted inputs or gravity-only prediction.
p400 associates Corke with MATLAB/Python, DH and education, and ROS2+MoveIt with KDL recursive NE for real robots, in that stated order. Others reverse or substitute the other named source rows.
p400 Pinocchio row lists C++/Python and NE,ABA,CRBA; Brax row lists Python/JAX differentiable dynamics for gradient optimization. Specified ordered pair removes the prior ambiguity.
p400 associates PyBullet/MuJoCo with RL-environment simulators and Drake with multibody dynamics and MPC, in that order. Alternatives reverse or substitute other actual table associations.
M(q) multiplies acceleration; C(q,qdot)qdot is the velocity-dependent term; g(q) gravity. These are the actual displayed matrix-equation roles.

Additive residual target equals matched measured minus nominal torque: (5,4)-(4,6)=(1,-2) Nm. Retain nominal mechanics and add the learned residual: (4,6)+(1,-2)=(5,4). Negating, using total torque as residual or discarding nominal each fails the stated reconstruction. This adds target construction/application, not another list of AI labels.
